public_mechanism.family: Tabu Search short-term memory with aspiration criterion
public_mechanism.primary_source: Fred Glover, Tabu Search—Part I / tutorial material
source_supported_core: short-term tabu memory can forbid reverse or repeated moves to prevent cycling
tabu tenure can be finite and expire after a bounded number of iterations
an aspiration criterion may override a tabu restriction when the candidate improves the best solution attained so far
public_mechanism.adaptation: Persist only the reverse-move attribute and a two-committed-decision tenure in role-local state; use a predeclared same-scope terminal-readback aspiration threshold. No external optimizer or hosted executor is used.

scope_limit: Constructed three-decision role-local assignment-switch trace only. This does not establish Tabu Search optimization superiority, globally optimal tabu tenure, or utility calibration beyond the fixed trace.
exact_next_action: After independent readback, advance once with credit_delta=1. Next leaf should test stagnation from repeated near-duplicate assignments: preserve a compact archive of behavior descriptors and require the next switch candidate to enter an underrepresented behavior cell unless a same-cell candidate clears a predeclared aspiration margin. Precommit before any new public semantic read.
